title: Data Breach Response Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your risk level after a data breach and get personalized response steps to protect your identity and minimize damage.
description: Assess your personal risk level following a data breach and receive tailored recommendations for immediate action. This calculator helps you prioritize response steps based on the type of data compromised and your current security posture.

inputs.label: What type of data was compromised?
inputs.helpText: Select the most sensitive type of data that was compromised in the breach

inputs.label: How long ago did the breach occur?
inputs.helpText: Earlier action reduces risk - immediate response is most effective

inputs.label: Do you reuse the compromised password elsewhere?
inputs.helpText: Password reuse significantly increases your risk exposure

inputs.label: Do you have two-factor authentication enabled?
inputs.helpText: 2FA provides crucial additional protection even if passwords are compromised

inputs.label: Do you use identity/credit monitoring services?
inputs.helpText: Active monitoring helps detect fraudulent activity quickly

inputs.label: Have you taken any response actions yet?
inputs.helpText: Previous actions reduce your current risk level

outputFields.label: Overall Risk Level
outputFields.description: Your current risk level on a scale of 1-100

outputFields.label: Risk Grade
outputFields.description: Letter grade indicating your risk category

outputFields.label: Response Urgency
outputFields.description: How quickly you should take action

outputFields.label: Immediate Actions Needed
outputFields.description: Number of critical actions you should take immediately

formula: let baseRisk = 20; const dataTypeRisk = {email: 10, passwords: 30, personal: 25, financial: 40, ssn: 50, medical: 35, multiple: 45}; const timeRisk = {hours: 0, recent: 5, weeks: 10, months: 15, old: 5}; const passwordRisk = {no: 0, few: 15, sometimes: 25, everywhere: 35}; const authProtection = {none: 20, some: 10, most: 5, all: 0}; const monitoringReduction = monitoringServices ? -5 : 0; const actionReduction = {none: 0, password: -10, some: -20, comprehensive: -35}; let riskScore = Math.max(5, Math.min(95, baseRisk + dataTypeRisk[dataTypes] + timeRisk[timeSinceBreach] + passwordRisk[passwordReuse] + authProtection[twoFactorAuth] + monitoringReduction + actionReduction[actionsTaken])); let riskGrade = riskScore >= 80 ? 'F' : riskScore >= 65 ? 'D' : riskScore >= 50 ? 'C' : riskScore >= 35 ? 'B' : 'A'; let urgencyLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'IMMEDIATE' : riskScore >= 50 ? 'Within 24 hours' : riskScore >= 30 ? 'Within a week' : 'Monitor regularly'; let priorityActions = Math.ceil(riskScore / 20); return {riskScore, riskGrade, urgencyLevel, priorityActions};

educational.methodology: This calculator assesses your data breach risk based on the sensitivity of compromised data, time elapsed since breach discovery, your current security practices, and actions already taken. Higher scores indicate greater vulnerability to identity theft and fraud.
tips: Change passwords immediately on the breached service and any accounts using the same password
Enable two-factor authentication on all critical accounts (banking, email, social media)
Monitor your credit reports and consider placing fraud alerts or credit freezes
Use a password manager to generate unique passwords for each account
Browse privately with Incognito Browser to prevent further data collection
Sign up for identity monitoring services if you haven't already
Document all breach-related communications for potential future reference

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Your risk is minimal. Continue monitoring and maintain good security practices.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Take precautionary steps and improve your security posture within a week.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant risk present. Take immediate action within 24 hours.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Extreme vulnerability. Take all protective measures immediately.
